title: No anniversary???
body:
I cannot believe that the calendar show birthday from a contact but doesnt show any anniversary from the contact?!?!?!?

Never saw something so stupid!!!
author: Mirko tosic

title: Big disadvantage
body: Add an option to insert phone number out of recent numbers (or contacts) into new reminder.
